mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase sulfasalazine metabolism, while sulfasalazine may affect eslicarbazepine levels through metabolic interactions and both drugs carry risk of hematologic adverse effects.
action: Monitor for reduced eslicarbazepine efficacy and sulfasalazine effectiveness; obtain baseline and periodic CBC to assess for hematologic toxicity; consider therapeutic drug monitoring if seizure control is suboptimal.
